notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Post-processing step for crt.sh output — extracts, sorts, and deduplicates all unique subdomains from the JSON certificate transparency dump. Produces a clean list for downstream resolution and scanning.

=== CHAINING ===
crtsh-json → pipe through jq + sed + sort -u → write to subdomains.txt → host/dig loop for resolution → filter to company IPs → nmap active scan.

=== PATTERN ===
Combined with host-resolve-subdomains, this two-step pipeline is the standard passive subdomain enumeration workflow before any active scanning begins.
